```{r}
# From https://distillery.rbind.io/posts/2021-03-24-customizing-distill-with-htmltools-and-css/

make_icon <- function(icon) {
  htmltools::tag("i", list(class = icon))
}

make_icon_text <- function(icon, text = "") {
  if (is.null(text)) text <- ""
  htmltools::HTML(paste0(as.character(make_icon(icon)), " ", text))
}

icon_link <- function(icon = NULL, text = "", url = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(icon)) {
    text <- make_icon_text(icon, text)
  }

  htmltools::a(href = url, text, class = "icon-link")
}
```

```{r}
name <- "{{name}}"
affiliation <- "{{affiliation}}"
role <- "{{role}}"
email <- "{{email}}"
image <- "{{image}}"
webpage <- "{{webpage}}"
github <- "{{github}}"
twitter <- "{{twitter}}"
bluesky <- "{{bluesky}}"
orcid <- "{{orcid}}"
description <- "{{description}}"

name_link <- name
if (webpage != "") {
  name_link <- htmltools::a(name, href = webpage)
}

title <- htmltools::div(
  htmltools::div(name_link, class = "team-member-name"),
  htmltools::div(affiliation, class = "team-member-affiliation"),
  if (role != "") htmltools::div(role, class = "team-member-role")
)

if (email != "") {
  title <- htmltools::div(title, icon_link("bi bi-envelope", url = paste0("mailto:", email)))
}

if (twitter != "") {
  title <- htmltools::div(title, icon_link("bi bi-twitter", url = paste0("https://twitter.com/", twitter)))
}

if (orcid != "") {
  title <- htmltools::div(title, icon_link("ai ai-orcid", url = paste0("https://orcid.org/", orcid)))
}

if (bluesky != "") {
  title <- htmltools::div(title, icon_link("bi bi-bluesky", url = paste0("https://", bluesky)))
}
```
